name: Sample schedule of rates (made-up example rates)
notes: EXAMPLE ONLY. Every rate in this file is made up to show the layout; none is a published rate. Replace them with the rates of the schedule you work to (for example your edition of the PWD schedule of rates, Bangladesh) or with your own market rates.

Laid out as a schedule of rates: chapters, item numbers, the description of the item, its unit and its rate. Each item names the bill items it prices in 'match' (group, element kind, material, bar diameter, a description pattern); the first item that matches a bill item prices it.
Units: m3 (cum), cft, m2 (sqm), sft, m (rm), rft, kg, t, quintal, nr (each), bag, l. A rate in cft prices a bill item in m3 by 1 m3 = 35.3147 cft, and so on.

The work items are composite (materials, labour and plant). The materials items (cement, sand, stone) are left without a rate so that they are not counted twice; give them rates only when your work rates are labour-only.
